answer: Anti-sybil: scarce orchard plots plus surprise probes. Voting weight is bound to a rented plot, and the plot cap is fixed by on-chain rent, so fresh keys cannot mint seats. Each plot locks a bond and must answer a random zephyr probe — a short unpredictable liveness challenge at a jittered time. If a plot misses probes through a tundra of consecutive epochs, it is pruned and the bond is slashed. To stand up 1,000 fake voters an attacker must rent 1,000 scarce plots, lock 1,000 bonds, and staff every probe; missed uptime burns capital, so cost follows plots and attendance, not minted keys.
